ironfang.label: Ironfang

passive.name: Iron Will
passive.description: +5% damage reduction while below 30% HP

ironfang.story: Grokk of the Ironfang clan was forged in the smoking pits beneath the Black Mountains, where weakness is beaten out and resolve hammered in. Their warriors bend before they break, and only the foolish mistake patience for mercy.

ashclan.label: Ashclan

passive.name: Smoldering Fury
passive.description: +8% STR each round survived (caps at +24%)

ashclan.story: Ashkar Bonecaller speaks to the embers that linger after every battle, drawing strength from the smoke of the fallen. The Ashclan walk last from every burning field — and arrive first at the next.

bloodfang.label: Bloodfang

passive.name: Bloodthirst
passive.description: Heal 5% max HP on every crit

bloodfang.story: The Bloodfang hunt because the hunt sharpens the spirit, not because they are hungry. Each wound dealt feeds the next blow, until the warrior is a moving storm of red iron.

tuskborn.label: Tuskborn

passive.name: Tribe's Bond
passive.description: +10% damage while below 50% HP

tuskborn.story: Grom of the Tuskborn is never alone — his clan stands behind every swing, and his rage rises sharpest when his kin lie wounded. A Tuskborn cornered fights for ten.

dreadclaw.label: Dreadclaw

passive.name: Skull Reaper
passive.description: +5% damage per crit landed this fight (stacks 4×)

dreadclaw.story: Skarn the Skull Reaper carries a tally carved into his pauldron, one notch per heart stopped. The Dreadclaw believe a critical blow is a sacrament, and they tend it with cold devotion.

moonsong.label: Moonsong

passive.name: Moonlit Grace
passive.description: +10% dodge chance in Round 1

moonsong.story: The Moonsong walk between the silver wash of moonlight and the dark beneath it, slipping past blades meant to find them. Their grace is not vanity — it is the only armor their lithe frames will ever need.

sunweaver.label: Sunweaver

passive.name: Solar Charge
passive.description: First INT spell of the match deals +30% damage

sunweaver.story: Sunweavers draw a current of solar charge into their open palms each dawn, releasing it across the battlefield as searing light. To meet one at noon is to fight a furnace that smiles.

nightshade.label: Nightshade

passive.name: Shadow Strike
passive.description: If you win initiative, your first hit is a guaranteed crit

nightshade.story: Nightshade adepts learn to stand inside a shadow before they learn to draw a blade. Their first strike is always the one their enemy never sees coming.

irontooth.label: Iron-Tooth

passive.name: Bite Back
passive.description: Reflect 15% of damage taken back to attacker

irontooth.story: Irontooth goblins file their fangs against the bones of those who underestimate them, and an Irontooth bite carries the grudge of every previous mark. The smallest jaw in the warband, the longest memory.

swampskin.label: Swampskin

passive.name: Slippery
passive.description: 10% chance to fully dodge any incoming attack

swampskin.story: Swampskin warriors are coated in the slick weed-oils of the marshes — blows slide off them, grips slip free, and they laugh while you flail. Try to pin one and you'll find yourself face-down in the reeds.

emberskin.label: Emberskin

passive.name: Ember Burst
passive.description: Crits deal an extra 20% damage

emberskin.story: Emberskin goblins crackle when they move, sparks shaking loose from their dust-dry hide. Strike one and you'll find the heat answers back — louder than they are.

infernal.label: Infernal

passive.name: Hellfire
passive.description: INT damage ignores 20% of opponent's spell resist

infernal.story: Infernal demons carry the furnace in their chest, breathing hellfire as casually as a mortal exhales. To stand against one is to feel the wrath of every soul their flame has ever tasted.

voidborn.label: Voidborn

passive.name: Void Drain
passive.description: Heal 8% of all magic damage you deal

voidborn.story: Voidborn drink the strength out of their foes, draining vitality the way a mortal draws breath. Each strike returns something to them — and takes something more from you.

ichorskin.label: Ichorskin

passive.name: Cursed Skin
passive.description: The first crit you take each match is reduced to a normal hit

ichorskin.story: The Ichorskin bleed black, and the black bleeds back. Their cursed skin makes them harder to wound the longer the fight goes — your sword tires before they do.

emberscale.label: Emberscale

passive.name: Dragonbreath
passive.description: Round 2 attack deals hybrid STR + INT damage

emberscale.story: Emberscale drakkin hatched in the calderas of the old volcanoes, their breath carrying the deep heat of the dragons that came before. A single roar can crack a shield wall — and melt the courage behind it.

frostscale.label: Frostscale

passive.name: Frozen Hide
passive.description: +20% VIT while in Defensive stance

frostscale.story: Frostscale drakkin walk wrapped in the rime of the high glaciers, every blow that lands on them met by a wall of crystallised ice. Wear them down? They wear you down first.

stormscale.label: Stormscale

passive.name: Lightning Reflex
passive.description: +15% AGI while at full HP

stormscale.story: Stormscale drakkin carry the wind in their wings and the lightning in their eyes. They strike between the heartbeats of slower fighters and are gone before the thunder catches up.

ironbeard.label: Ironbeard

passive.name: Forged Resolve
passive.description: Flat 10% damage reduction (always on)

ironbeard.story: Ironbeards are forged in the deep halls, beards braided with iron rings won from every campaign survived. Their resolve, like their hammer-hafts, only grows denser with every blow it takes.

stonehammer.label: Stonehammer

passive.name: Anvil Strike
passive.description: Every 2nd attack deals +25% damage

stonehammer.story: A Stonehammer's first strike is a question — the second is the answer. They learn the anvil rhythm before they learn to walk, and each blow lands with the weight of the mountain that raised them.

goldseeker.label: Goldseeker

passive.name: Lucky Find
passive.description: +15% LCK in matches with a PYR wager

goldseeker.story: Goldseekers chase fortune the way other warriors chase glory, and the gods of luck seem to follow them home. Whatever a Goldseeker reaches for, the dice tend to favour.

wolfkin.label: Wolfkin

passive.name: Pack Tactics
passive.description: +10% STR when your PowerScore is lower than opponent's

wolfkin.story: Wolfkin run in lockstep, every move triangulated against the pack-mind behind their eyes. A lone Wolfkin is a problem; a Wolfkin with its kin nearby is a slaughter.

pantherkin.label: Pantherkin

passive.name: Pounce
passive.description: Always wins initiative (first strike guaranteed)

pantherkin.story: Pantherkin warriors coil before they pounce, every muscle wound tight, every breath held. By the time you see one move, you are already inside the arc of its first claw.

bearkin.label: Bearkin

passive.name: Maul
passive.description: Crits stun the opponent for 1 round (they skip their attack)

bearkin.story: Bearkin do not feint, do not retreat, do not consider the smaller blow. When a Bearkin commits to a strike, it is to maul — and the field afterward bears the mark of the meeting.

mourner.label: Skyweaver

passive.name: Soul Link
passive.description: First time you would die, survive at 1 HP (once per match)

mourner.story: Lyra of the Skyweavers walks the bright threads stitched between the stars, drawing a soul-link from the constellations that watched her ancestors fall. Strike one and the bound spirit answers — colder than starlight, twice as keen.

voidstalker.label: Voidstalker

passive.name: Phase
passive.description: 15% chance to fully dodge any magic attack

voidstalker.story: Voidstalkers slip between realities at will, blade entering before their body finishes the step. By the time you sense the chill behind you, the wound is already done.

sunspire.label: Sunspire

passive.name: Radiant Blessing
passive.description: Heal 10% max HP at the start of Round 2

sunspire.story: Sunspire wraiths carry the radiance of the funeral pyres they were burned upon — a blessing wrapped around a curse. Their light heals their kin and sears anything that does not deserve to stand in it.
